subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 5: Culture – Some unusual jobs
outcomes: Use must to say what people in a job must do.
Write about jobs in your family: what they do and where they work.

tf.s: The boat driver works in a cave.
tf.why: Yes! The boat driver works in a cave in England.

tf.s: Visitors in the cave must wear a special hard hat.
tf.why: Correct! A hard hat keeps them safe.

tf.s: A professional sleeper checks how good beds and pillows are.
tf.why: Well done! That is the sleeper's job.

tf.s: A tea taster tries three cups of tea every day.
tf.why: The tea taster tries 300 cups every day!

tf.s: You must train for five years to be a tea taster.
The cave in the text has an underground lake.
tf.why: Correct! The boat goes on an underground lake.

tf.s: A professional sleeper works in a cave.
tf.why: The boat driver works in a cave. The sleeper tests beds.

tf.s: 'A doctor must help people' uses must.
'A doctor works in a school' is correct.
tf.why: A doctor works in a hospital.

tf.s: The tea taster uses a big pillow.
tf.why: The tea taster uses a long spoon. Pillows are for the sleeper.

boxes.q: Where does the boat driver work?
boxes.why: He works in a cave with an underground lake.

boxes.q: What must visitors wear in the cave?
boxes.why: A hard hat keeps visitors safe.

boxes.q: How many cups does the tea taster try a day?
boxes.why: The tea taster tries 300 cups every day.

boxes.q: How long must a tea taster train?
boxes.why: You must train for five years.
A doctor works in a hospital.
A teacher works in a school.
Sleeping as a job is unusual!

mcq.q: Which job is in a cave?
mcq.why: The boat driver works in Speedwell Cavern.

mcq.q: In which country is the cave?
What does a professional sleeper check?
o: how good beds and pillows are
mcq.why: The sleeper tests beds and pillows.

mcq.q: Which three questions are in the job book project?
o: What's the job? What must the person do? Where does the person work?
What's your name? What's your address? What's your phone number?
How old are you? Where do you live? What do you like?
What's the weather? What time is it? What day is it?
mcq.why: The project asks about the job, its rules and its place.

mcq.q: Complete: A ___ must help animals. He works in a clinic.

o: A firefighter must help people and put out fires.
A firefighter must to help people.

mcq.q: Choose the best page for the job book.
o: Job: doctor. A doctor must help people. A doctor works in a hospital.
Job: doctor. A doctor must fix cars. A doctor works in a garage.
Job: doctor. A doctor mustn't help people.
Job: doctor. A doctor works in a cave.
mcq.why: It answers all three questions correctly.

mcq.q: Why must visitors wear a hard hat in the cave?
Why is 'tea taster' an unusual job?
o: The person tries 300 cups of tea every day.
The person works in a school.
mcq.why: Not many people taste tea as a job!
The boat driver works in a cave.
